# Ferronit

> Ferronit is a high-performance Python ASGI framework with a Rust core: routing, request
> parsing, JSON, gzip and CORS are implemented in Rust (`ferronit._core`), while business logic
> stays plain Python with DDD/CQRS, hexagonal ports and DI. The data layer is rawdb + rawmodel
> for PostgreSQL (asyncpg), MySQL (aiomysql) and SQLite (aiosqlite); all three drivers are
> optional extras. Python ≥ 3.12, abi3-py312 (one wheel for 3.12+).
> Benchmarks: 117 536 req/s on Granian versus 18 777 for FastAPI (×6.3).

This file is a short map for language models and agents.

## Essentials

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents — structure, commands, invariants, style, work boundaries
- [README.md](README.md): overview, installation, benchmarks, Docker, release — the main README (English)
- [README.ru.md](README.ru.md): the same in Russian
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Apache License 2.0
- [docs/security/ASVS.md](docs/security/ASVS.md): OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 1 compliance map (17/70)
- [examples/app.py](examples/app.py): full example — DDD + CQRS + hexagonal + rawdb/rawmodel

## Public API

- Application: `ferronit.Ferronit` (`@app.route`, `@app.websocket`, `app.use`, `app.mount`, `@app.lifespan`, `app.container`)
- Request/response: `ferronit.Request`, `ferronit.Response`, `ferronit.Headers`, `ferronit.JSONResponse`, `ferronit.StreamingResponse`, `ferronit.TextResponse`
- DDD: `ferronit.ddd` — `AggregateRoot`, `Command`, `Query` (both `msgspec.Struct`, hence serialisable), `CommandBus`, `QueryBus`, `Repository`
- Ports and adapters: `ferronit.hexagonal` — `Port`, `Adapter`, `UnitOfWork`, `ApplicationService`, `Logger`, `Cache`, `MessageBus`, `EventBus`
- DI: `ferronit.di.Container` (singleton/factory/get/has); parameter binding — `ferronit.binding`; config: `ferronit.config.EnvConfig`
- Database: `ferronit.contrib.rawdb` + `rawmodel` (no ORM, three optional drivers: asyncpg/aiomysql/aiosqlite) — `Pool`, `create_pool`, `RawUnitOfWork`, `Model`, `Relation`, query DSL
- LLM: `ferronit.contrib.llm` — `LlmPort`, `OpenAiAdapter`, `ClaudeAdapter`, `MockLlmAdapter`
- Vector search: `ferronit.contrib.vectordb` — `VectorDbPort`, `QdrantAdapter`, `ChromaAdapter`, `MockVectorDb`
- Other: `ferronit.contrib.cors`, `security`, `ratelimit`, `staticfiles`, `tracing`, `health`, `kafka`, `pydantic`

## Commands

```bash
./scripts/check.sh        # lint → types → Rust core build → tests
poetry run pytest tests/ -q
poetry run ferronit dev --server granian
poetry run ferronit run --workers 4
docker build -t ferronit:0.24.0 . && ./scripts/docker_smoke.sh
```

## Optional

- The benchmark stand is a separate repository, ferronit-bench (https://github.com/ivlevdenis/ferronit-bench): scripts, methodology and charts, not part of the package
